{{Quote|Doctor Orlian's been acting suspicious ever since the security systems went down.|Jesh|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Jesh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Stationed on [[Quesh]] during the [[Quesh war]], he attempted to prevent defection of Imperial scientist [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Orlian]] by taking him into custody and torturing him to get the name of his [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] contact. When [[Attis Station]] was attacked by a Republic citizen looking to extract Orlian, Jesh and his men attempted to stop him, but were killed during the fighting.
